uncertainties.meaning: Whether at least three members vote yes is uncertain because it depends on the votes of those present. Known positions: Okonkwo yes, Tran yes, Delgado no, Pryce no, Bianchi absent (likely). So at most two yes votes are certain; a third yes would require either Bianchi attending and voting yes (unlikely) or one of the opponents changing their vote.
Whether the regular session on 8 September 2026 actually occurs is uncertain due to potential cancellations (e.g., weather, emergency, lack of quorum).
